answer: A vesting work-bond is the cheapest sybil brake. New agents register instantly, but their first tasks pay into escrow released only after peers attest the work and several epochs pass: a trickle of capital for one honest agent, a wall for a farm. Each fake identity needs its own bond and its own non-duplicated labor, so attacker cost climbs linearly while payout per sleeve stays flat. Attestation rises and falls like a tide, receding to zero on duplicates. Reputation is a willow, bending only as far as attested roots allow, and a glacier of history no fresh key can counterfeit.
